ui.UI_EMPTY_NOT_QUALIFIED: Your city is not yet qualified for this season.
ui.UI_PRIZE_PAYS_STOCKS: Prize pays the six stocks, not $CORP. One wallet, one slot. Claim is not confirmed custody.
ui.UI_QUALIFY_OPEN: This city has not met the season qualification requirements.
ui.UI_QUALIFY_LEAD: To qualify for the season, your city must meet both conditions:
ui.UI_PRIZE_GATE: {count} positive days in the period, and a live stake at settlement.
ui.UI_QUALIFY_DAYS: Minimum {count} positive days in the period (GDP/day > 0).
ui.UI_OPEN_SPENDS_CORP: Opening spends $CORP. Buying the stock ≠ stake ≠ opening the industry.
ui.UI_FROZEN_HINT: Buildings remain, they do not produce.
ui.UI_VAULT_HINT: deposited to vault for Capital mint into the wage fund, not the player's wallet.
ui.UI_PROTOCOL_NOTE: Trading fees buy $CORP into the vault and stocks into prize kettles. This is not city Treasury and not the player's $CORP. Buyback runs outside the economic tick. No Claim button on this plaque.
ui.UI_OFFLINE_CAUGHT_UP: The server caught this city up.
ui.UI_PAYROLL_LAUNCH_WINDOW: Launch window ×{mult} · ends in {days} city days
ui.UI_DECORATIVE: No economic function. Not in the pack.
ui.UI_EXCHANGE_NO_TRADE: Buying a stock token does not open its industry. No live quote — no trade.
ui.UI_MARKET_VS_EFFICIENCY: Market is the stock ticker. Effect is district efficiency. They are not one number.
ui.UI_BANK_DEPOSIT_HOURS: Deposit is not restricted by Bank hours.
ui.UI_NO_RESPEC: This choice cannot be respecced under the current rules.
ui.UI_MERGE_ACTIVE_CAP: Active merges are a matching. Cap {n}.
ui.UI_ESTIMATE_AFTER_QUOTE: Estimate after fees and bank quote
ui.UI_ENTRY_CHEAPER: Entering Capital is always cheaper than withdrawing Capital.
ui.UI_DEPOSIT_HINT: Mint Capital by depositing $CORP into the city vault.
ui.UI_WITHDRAW_HINT: Move Capital from the city treasury to your $CORP wallet.
ui.UI_AUTHORIZE_HINT: Reserve limit and create voucher. This is not a wallet transfer.
ui.UI_RANKING_HINT: One slot per wallet. Best city only.
ui.UI_LEADERBOARD_HINT: Zipf top-10 of the period prize pool. Ranking and prize are two tables.
ui.UI_BOARD_UNQUALIFIED: This city is not qualified yet.
ui.UI_PRIZE_SLOT: One wallet, one slot. Prize is not confirmed custody.
ui.UI_FRAGMENTS_HINT: Fragment claims are the DEX farm leg, not the season.
ui.UI_TOPUP_HINT: Deposit $CORP in the Bank to mint Capital.
ui.UI_DEACTIVATE_HINT: Deactivation does not free the function slot and does not remove the building from the island. No refund.
ui.UI_HIRE_HINT: Hire spends Capital. Without role selection — {pool}. {explicit} only by explicit choice.
ui.UI_UNSTAKE_HINT: Below the minimum, the industry freezes after a delay.
ui.UI_UNSTAKE_CONFIRM: tokens return to the wallet no sooner than {days} city days, and there is no cancel
ui.UI_UNSTAKE_RESTARTS: the timer on the current cooldown restarts for the whole amount
